source: HuggingFace Toridion/lindisfarne-m1, full tier, chunks records_0001.jsonl + records_0002.jsonl (20,000 synthetic NHS records; 6,798 FHIR R4, 6,720 HL7 v2.5, 5,658 SNOMED, 824 GHX)
answer_format: names 'First Last'; dates YYYY-MM-DD; numbers plain (no separators); booleans 'true'/'false'; name lists comma-separated alphabetical; record-ID lists comma-separated ascending (REC-XXXXXXXX); contract values exactly as stored (e.g. '£3,074,270'); verified-empty questions: 'no matching records'
multihop_hops: a hop = one resolution step: (1) resolve key or filter to record(s), (2) read a list/nested field, (3) select an item inside it, (4) read its attribute, (5) filter/count over it. metadata.hops records the intended depth (2-5).

categories.lookup: single attribute of a uniquely-keyed record (record ID / NHS number / name+DOB)
categories.filter: one or two conditions; answer is a list (names alphabetical or record IDs ascending)
categories.multihop: 2-5 hops: key/filter/superlative -> record -> list selection -> attribute -> count; difficulty rises with hop count (see metadata.hops)
categories.aggregate: counts over filtered groups, computed over the full 20k corpus
categories.superlative: oldest/youngest/earliest/latest/highest with a machine-verified unique winner
categories.temporal: before/after ordering and which-came-first over dated events within a record
categories.cross_format: questions spanning FHIR R4 / HL7 v2.5 / SNOMED encodings of the same concept
categories.procurement: GHX procurement records: contracts, projects, workplans, cohorts
categories.unanswerable: verified-empty questions (zero matching records) — hallucination resistance
